Side view 1:10 with a visitor 1.75 m tall
24 sheets A2 joined along the long edge, folded 420 x 594, 10.08 m unfolded, drawn 1:15
24 sheets A2 portrait, spiral bound, open 850 x 594, drawn 1:15

Low pedestal 900 x 900 x 450, 938 high with the model (308 x 225 in plan), which stands 40 from the far edge, centred across, its door towards the prints and the visitor. The 24 A2 sheets of this set lie in front of it, open at sheets 10 and 11, as a booklet or as an accordion. The pedestal is drawn as one volume; its boards are not designed yet.
